fbdfce.title: Target map and engagement constraints
fbdfce.content:
**Assets**

- Web application: `https://sahamlens.id`
- Local source: `/workspace/app` (live writable mount of `/opt/sahamlens/app`)

**Mode**

Combined white-box + black-box, production low-risk/non-destructive.

**Constraints**

- No credential brute force or password guessing.
- No DoS/load testing or high-rate scans.
- No destructive payloads.
- Do not create/update/delete real records or submit state-changing production forms.
- Prefer source-guided checks, passive/low-rate recon, headers/TLS/cookie flags, exposed routes, public API behavior, auth boundary observations, common misconfigurations, reflected-only non-persistent XSS probes, IDOR review without mutation.

cb7e58.title: Production configuration review observations for sahamlens.id
cb7e58.content:
Low-risk production configuration review performed against `https://sahamlens.id` using safe `GET`/`HEAD`/`OPTIONS` requests only. No forms were submitted and no state-changing requests were made.

**Scope covered**
- TLS protocol negotiation using `openssl s_client`.
- HTTP to HTTPS redirect behavior.
- Security headers on `/`, auth pages, selected admin pages, public metadata, and API endpoints.
- CORS behavior on `/api/health` with arbitrary `Origin` values and preflight requests.
- Cookie flags visible without login.
- Safe admin route/API gating using unauthenticated `GET`/`HEAD` only.
- Public source map/debug/config file exposure checks.
- Public sitemap and robots review.

**Positive observations**
- HTTP redirects to HTTPS with `301`.
- HSTS is present on HTTPS responses: `strict-transport-security: max-age=15552000; includeSubDomains; preload`.
- Core browser security headers are broadly present: `Content-Security-Policy`, `X-Frame-Options: DENY`, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin`, `Permissions-Policy`, and `Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin`.
- CORS checks did not return `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` for arbitrary origins (`https://example.invalid`, `https://evil.invalid`, or `null`) on `/api/health`; preflight returned `204` with `Allow: GET, HEAD, OPTIONS` but no permissive ACAO.
- No unauthenticated cookies were set on sampled pages (`/`, `/login`, `/signup`, `/forgot-password`, `/reset-password`, `/admin-login`, `/api/health`, `/api/admin-status`, `/api/auth/me`).
- Admin APIs sampled without authentication (`/api/admin/stats`, `/api/admin/jobs`, `/api/admin/pro-status`) returned `403 Forbidden` JSON.
- Admin pages sampled without authentication returned no admin content markers; responses contained redirect markers toward `/admin-login` and `Cache-Control: private, no-cache, no-store, max-age=0, must-revalidate`.
- Public debug/config paths checked with safe HEAD returned `404`: `/.env`, `/.env.production`, `/.git/HEAD`, `/server-status`, `/phpinfo.php`, `/__nextjs_original-stack-frames`, `/_next/webpack-hmr`.
- Source-map checks for current public `_next/static` bundle names returned `404` for tested `.js.map` candidates.
- `robots.txt` disallows `/api/`, `/admin`, `/admin-login`, and `/_workbench`; sitemap entries reviewed at a high level did not include admin paths in the sampled content.

**Hardening observations / inconclusive items**
- TLS 1.0 and TLS 1.1 handshakes succeeded via the Cloudflare edge (`Protocol version: TLSv1` and `TLSv1.1`, cipher `ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-SHA`, SHA1 handshake). This is a standards/compliance hardening issue and should be disabled if no legacy clients require it. I did not file a vulnerability report because no attacker-controlled downgrade or concrete data exposure was demonstrated in this low-risk review.
- Production responses expose `Server: cloudflare` and `x-powered-by: Next.js`. This is version/banner metadata only; no concrete exploit chain was validated.
- CSP is present and restrictive in several places, but includes `script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'` and `style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'`. No XSS sink or executable injection was tested/confirmed as part of this configuration-only task, so this remains hardening guidance rather than a filed issue.
- Public unauthenticated auth pages (`/login`, `/signup`, `/forgot-password`, `/reset-password`, `/admin-login`) return `Cache-Control: s-maxage=31536000`. Source and dynamic checks showed tested query markers were not reflected in server responses, and no cookies/personal data were present, so no cache disclosure impact was demonstrated. Consider lowering shared-cache TTL for authentication and recovery pages as a defense-in-depth measure.
- Repository listing revealed multiple local `.env.production*` backup filenames in `/workspace/app`; contents were not read for this production configuration task. This is not a live web exposure based on the public checks above, but the repository should avoid retaining environment backup files if they contain secrets.

7df11d.title: Configuration review completed without reportable finding
7df11d.content: Production configuration review completed with no filed vulnerability. Noted hardening items include legacy TLS at the CDN edge, exposed framework banner, CSP allowing inline script/style, and long shared-cache headers on public authentication pages. No direct unauthorized data access, modification, or service disruption was demonstrated.

039cad.title: SahamLens low-risk recon endpoint inventory
039cad.content:
**Scope:** `https://sahamlens.id` only. Low-rate/read-only recon artifacts are in `/workspace/recon-lowrisk-a1fba2a1`.

**Technology/fingerprint:** Cloudflare edge/WAF, HTTPS, HTTP/3, HSTS, Next.js/React/Webpack/Node.js. TLS certificate CN `sahamlens.id`, SANs `sahamlens.id` and `*.sahamlens.id`, issuer Google Trust Services `WE1`, valid `2026-08-12` to `2026-11-10`.

**Public files:**
- `GET /robots.txt` → `200`, allows `/`, disallows `/api/`, `/admin`, `/admin-login`, `/_workbench`, declares sitemap.
- `GET /sitemap.xml` → `200`, 969 URLs, mostly `/technical/<IDX_SYMBOL>` pages.
- `GET /manifest.json` → `200`, PWA metadata/icons only.
- `/.well-known/security.txt`, `/security.txt`, `/asset-manifest.json`, `/humans.txt` → `404` Next.js HTML page.

**Primary page inventory:** `/`, `/about`, `/market-pulse`, `/breakout-radar`, `/watchlist`, `/dashboard`, `/fundamental`, `/ownership-flow`, `/compare`, `/screener`, `/calendar`, `/status`, `/privacy`, `/terms`, `/disclaimer`, `/technical/<symbol>`, `/market/top-gainer`, plus additional app routes surfaced from JS: `/backtest`, `/dcf`, `/dividend`, `/earnings`, `/macro`, `/moat`, `/news`, `/portfolio`, `/risk`, `/risk-calculator`, `/signup`, `/forgot-password`, `/reset-password`.

**Admin route inventory surfaced by JS/robots/crawl:** `/admin`, `/admin-login`, `/admin/jobs`, `/admin/data-integrity`, `/admin/bank-fundamentals`, `/admin/broker-eod`, `/admin/broker-summary`, `/admin/calibration`, `/admin/decision-lab`, `/admin/financial-integrity`, `/admin/foreign-flow`, `/admin/fundamental-backfill`, `/admin/infographic-studio`, `/admin/intraday-validation`, `/admin/lensai-feedback`, `/admin/macro-assumptions`, `/admin/ownership-flow`, `/admin/ownership-flow-validation`, `/admin/tpcl-validation`, `/admin/transparency`.

**API inventory observed from JS/browser/Caido:** public/read endpoints include `/api/market-summary`, `/api/market-pulse`, `/api/calendar`, `/api/daily-picks`, `/api/ai-pick`, `/api/news`, `/api/live/<symbol>`, `/api/public-chart/<symbol>?tf=1M`. Auth/role endpoints include `/api/auth/me`, `/api/admin-status`, `/api/watchlist`, `/api/ai-briefing`, `/api/auth/login`, `/api/auth/logout`, `/api/analytics/journey`, `/api/payment/notify`. Admin API calls observed from admin UI include `/api/admin/stats`, `/api/admin/jobs`, `/api/admin/pro-status`.

**Form/browser inventory:** Home has a stock search combobox and language/theme/notification controls. Login page has email/password inputs, remember-me checkbox, password reveal, forgot-password and signup links. Admin login page has an `ADMIN SECRET KEY` input and disabled submit until input is present. No credentials were guessed and no forms were submitted.

2807a7.title: SahamLens auth boundaries and security headers
2807a7.content:
**Security headers on `/`:**
- `Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=15552000; includeSubDomains; preload`
- `Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; base-uri 'self'; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://static.cloudflareinsights.com; connect-src 'self' https://*.ingest.sentry.io https://cloudflareinsights.com wss:; worker-src 'self' blob:; upgrade-insecure-requests`
- `X-Frame-Options: DENY`, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin`
- `Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin`
- `Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=(), usb=()`
- `Server: cloudflare`, `X-Powered-By: Next.js`, `Cache-Control: s-maxage=31536000`, `Vary: rsc, next-router-state-tree, next-router-prefetch, next-router-segment-prefetch, Accept-Encoding`

**Cookies:** No `Set-Cookie` header observed on unauthenticated GETs to `/`, `/login`, `/admin`, `/dashboard`, `/status`, `/screener`, `/market-pulse`, `/technical/BBCA`, or selected public APIs. Cookie flags could not be assessed without authenticated session issuance.

**Observed unauthenticated boundaries:**
- `/watchlist` and `/portfolio` return `307` to `/login?next=<path>&notice=login_required`.
- `/api/auth/me` returns `401` JSON: `{"authenticated":false,...}`.
- `/api/watchlist` returns `401` JSON with `UNAUTHENTICATED`.
- `/api/admin-status` returns `200` JSON with `{"isAdmin":false,...}`.
- Browser load of `/admin/jobs` renders an Admin Login page with required `ADMIN SECRET KEY`; no form submitted.
- Admin API endpoints observed in Caido (`/api/admin/stats`, `/api/admin/jobs`, `/api/admin/pro-status`) returned `403` when requested unauthenticated by page/browser activity.

**Low-risk observations:** The baseline headers are mostly strong. CSP contains `'unsafe-inline'` for scripts and styles, likely required by the Next.js app but worth reviewing during XSS validation because it weakens script-injection containment if an injection point is found. Public route HTML for `/admin*` returns `200` and renders client-side admin login rather than server redirect/404; this is not a vulnerability by itself because admin APIs returned `403`, but it provides a clear auth-boundary area for source-aware review.

d24dc3.title: SahamLens low-risk vulnerability hypotheses for validation
d24dc3.content:
These are **hypotheses only** from non-destructive reconnaissance; no report was filed.

**Admin client routes exposed as HTML:** `/admin` and multiple `/admin/*` routes return `200` and render an admin secret-key login UI, while admin API endpoints observed returned `403`. Validate source-side and/or with authorized non-mutating checks that every admin data/action endpoint enforces server-side authorization, not just UI gating. Priority: BFLA/authz review.

**Open redirect candidate in login `next`:** Caido already contained related GETs to `/login?next=https://example.invalid/...` and `/admin-login?next=https://example.invalid/...`, both returning `200` login/admin-login pages rather than an immediate redirect. This is not confirmed exploitable. Validate only with non-state-changing login-flow/source review or a controlled local test; do not authenticate or submit credentials in production.

**CSP containment review:** `script-src` and `style-src` include `'unsafe-inline'`. This is not a vulnerability without an injection point. Prioritize reflected/non-persistent XSS review of public search/query surfaces such as stock search, `/fundamental?symbol=...`, `/technical/<symbol>`, `/market/<category>`, and `next`/`notice` parameters, using safe reflection-only probes and source review.

**API authorization/IDOR candidates:** Public APIs observed: `/api/live/<symbol>`, `/api/public-chart/<symbol>?tf=1M`, `/api/news`, `/api/calendar`, `/api/daily-picks`, `/api/ai-pick`, `/api/market-summary`, `/api/market-pulse`. Authenticated APIs observed: `/api/watchlist`, `/api/auth/me`, `/api/ai-briefing`; admin APIs: `/api/admin/stats`, `/api/admin/jobs`, `/api/admin/pro-status`. Validate that auth-required resources never disclose tenant/user-specific data unauthenticated and that public stock-symbol parameters are limited to intended public market data. No unauthorized restricted data was observed during recon.

**Security.txt absent:** `/.well-known/security.txt` and `/security.txt` return `404`. This is an operational observation, not a vulnerability.

351adf.title: Source Architecture Map for /workspace/app
351adf.content:
## Repository and runtime

- **Application type:** Next.js 16 App Router application written in TypeScript/React.
- **Package/runtime:** `package.json` requires Node `>=22 <23`; scripts use `next dev --webpack -H 0.0.0.0 -p 3001`, `next build --webpack`, `vitest`, `eslint`, and `tsc --noEmit`.
- **Deployment/security config:** `next.config.mjs` applies global CSP/security headers, HSTS in production, `frame-ancestors 'none'`, `X-Frame-Options: DENY`, `nosniff`, strict referrer policy, and permanent `/citadel` plus temporary `/transparency -> /admin/transparency` redirects.
- **Architecture:** Next App Router routes under `app/`, domain modules under `modules/`, shared infrastructure under `shared/`, operational scripts under `scripts/`, DB migrations under `database/migrations/`, and scheduled job config under `config/scheduled-jobs.json`.
- **Primary modules:** user/auth/admin, portfolio, watchlist/alerts, technical/market/fundamental analysis, recommendation/backtest, macro, broker-flow, ownership-flow, payment, observability/validation, notification, AI chat/briefing.

## Route inventory

Artifacts written under `/workspace/.source-aware-2d0f42d9`:

- `api-route-map.json`: 104 API route handlers with method/import/guard classification.
- `page-route-map.json`: 56 App Router pages with basic server-side guard markers.
- `ast-grep-summary.json`: bounded structural summary derived from Semgrep scanned-path scope.

Route groups identified:

- **Admin APIs:** 21 routes under `/api/admin/*`, `/api/admin-status`, and `/api/transparency`; most use `isAdminFromRequestCookies`, often with `assertTrustedSameOrigin` for state-changing actions. Some route files delegate auth to controllers (for example `/api/admin/broker-summary/import`).
- **Auth APIs:** `/api/auth/{login,logout,signup,verify,forgot-password,reset-password,me}` plus `/admin-login/key`.
- **User/session APIs:** portfolio, watchlist, alerts, profile/delete-account, AI account-limited endpoints, and entitlement-sensitive market-analysis endpoints.
- **Cron APIs:** 24 routes under `/api/cron/*`; many verify QStash signatures or `CRON_SECRET` through `verifyQStashSignature`; several GET/systemd routes use per-route `isAuthorized` helpers and `runCronRoute`.
- **Public/guest APIs:** market data, news, public chart, public analysis endpoints, analytics ingestion, and selected expensive compute endpoints with compute/rate budget guards.

## Auth, session, and authorization flows

- **User sessions:** `shared/auth/jwt.ts` signs/verifies HS256 JWTs with `JWT_SECRET_KEY`; `shared/auth/session.ts` reads HttpOnly `session` cookie, validates an `id` claim, touches presence asynchronously, and falls back to verified admin cookie for synthetic admin session.
- **Session cookies:** `modules/user/controller/auth.controller.ts` sets HttpOnly `session` cookies with `secure` in production, `sameSite: 'lax'`, and 24h/30d max age depending on remember-me.
- **Sliding refresh:** `proxy.ts` refreshes valid sessions after half of their token lifetime while preserving original lifetime.
- **Admin auth:** admin uses separate HttpOnly `sahamlens_admin` JWT signed by `ADMIN_JWT_SECRET` in production; DB-backed admin secret/session-version checking is in `shared/auth/admin-token-live.ts` and `modules/user/service/admin.service.ts`. UI badge cookies are explicitly non-authoritative.
- **Admin login:** `/admin-login/key` is POST-only, same-origin guarded, rate-limited in `proxy.ts`, and returns 404 for invalid secrets.
- **CSRF/same-origin:** state-changing browser endpoints generally call `assertTrustedSameOrigin`; this accepts allowed Origin values and rejects cross-site `Sec-Fetch-Site` values.
- **Protected pages:** `shared/constants/access.ts` currently treats `/portfolio` and `/watchlist` as login-required identity-owned pages; premium access is governed separately by `TESTING_OPEN_ACCESS` and live entitlement checks.
- **Proxy gate:** `proxy.ts` matches all `/api/:path*`, `/admin-login/:path*`, and protected/public app paths, with explicit exemptions for `/api/cron/*`, `/api/payment/notify`, `/api/health`, and `/api/company-logo`.

## Data stores and external trust boundaries

- **PostgreSQL:** `shared/database/postgres.client.ts` creates a lazy global `pg.Pool`, normalizes `sslmode` to `verify-full` for non-loopback DB hosts, and enforces certificate verification. Repositories use parameterized `pool.query` calls in reviewed examples.
- **Redis/cache:** `shared/cache/redis-cache.ts` uses Redis when `REDIS_URL` is present, with in-memory cache fallback for cache data only; quota/rate counters intentionally fail open in some business-quota paths if Redis is unavailable.
- **Rate limiting:** `shared/middleware/rate-limiter.ts`, `shared/security/api-rate-limit.ts`, and `shared/middleware/compute-budget.ts` enforce auth, public compute, AI, payment-notify, and expensive-route limits.
- **Scheduled jobs:** QStash/current-next signing keys or Bearer `CRON_SECRET` protect many scheduled endpoints; cron jobs write job-run logs and use concurrency guards for long-running tasks.
- **External data providers:** Yahoo Finance, IDX/KSEI/BI/public market/news feeds, company-logo proxy, Telegram notification, Upstash QStash, Sentry, AI providers, and payment notification workflows are key external boundaries.
- **High-value data:** users, admin secret hash/session version, payment orders, portfolios/transactions, watchlists/alerts, LensAI feedback, product journey/funnel events, fundamental/market/broker/ownership-flow historical data, scheduled job logs, and admin audit logs.

## Source-aware baseline results

Artifacts: `/workspace/.source-aware-2d0f42d9`.

- **Semgrep:** completed against 1,341 tracked files; 86 findings. Most observed examples are low-signal/static hygiene: plaintext HTTP links in fixture HTML, mutable GitHub Action tags, ReDoS audit hits in tests, replaceAll sanitization warnings, `.npmrc` release-age warning, and path-join traversal hypotheses.
- **AST-grep:** structural pass was derived from Semgrep scanned paths (`sg-targets.txt`) and reduced to `ast-grep-summary.json` to keep artifacts bounded.
- **Gitleaks:** completed and reported 2 `generic-api-key` hits in `app/admin/calibration/CalibrationClient.tsx`; manual context check showed they are false positives around numeric formatting/comment constants, not secret material.
- **Trivy fs:** completed with updated DB; scanned 459 packages, found **0 dependency vulnerabilities**, and 1 low Dockerfile misconfiguration (`DS-0026 No HEALTHCHECK defined`). No dependency CVE report was filed because no known CVE was identified.

## Hypotheses / areas for targeted follow-up

- **CSRF/state-changing public compute:** POST endpoints such as `/api/chat`, `/api/backtest`, `/api/explain`, `/api/risk-analysis`, `/api/ai-briefing`, and `/api/intrinsic-explain` do not consistently show `assertTrustedSameOrigin` at the route layer. Some are compute-only rather than data-mutating, but low-risk production validation should verify whether cross-site requests can consume user/IP budget or trigger AI/provider spend.
- **Cron GET authorization consistency:** several `/api/cron/*` GET/systemd routes use local `isAuthorized` helpers rather than visible `verifyQStashSignature`; low-risk validation should confirm unauthenticated GET returns 401/403 without executing work.
- **Admin API delegation:** some admin route files show no auth guard in the route itself because guards are delegated to controllers (`/api/admin/broker-summary/import`, `/api/admin/export`, `/api/admin/pro-status`, `/api/admin/stats`, `/api/admin-status`). Dynamic validation should confirm unauthenticated responses are non-sensitive.
- **SSRF/open proxy candidate:** `/api/company-logo?domain=...` proxies logo images based on a `domain` parameter. It is proxy-exempt and should be reviewed dynamically with harmless allow/deny cases to confirm strict host construction and no arbitrary internal URL fetch.
- **Path/file handling candidate:** Semgrep flagged path join/resolve traversal hypotheses in `modules/market/service/idx-foreign-flow.service.ts`; likely script/data-ingest related, but warrants manual trace if any user-controlled path reaches it.
- **IDOR-sensitive boundaries:** portfolio/watchlist/alerts use `requireUser()` and session IDs in controllers; dynamic tests should use only read-only unauthenticated checks in production unless test accounts are explicitly available.
